title: Hidden in Plain Sight
description: A mossy leaf-tailed gecko (Uroplatus sikorae) hides in plain sight on a rainforest tree in Mantadia National Park, Madagascar. These geckos have uncanny camouflaging abilities, which are needed in a forest full of keen-eyed predatory birds. At rest, they face downward in order to avoid reflections in their eyes that can alert birds above them to their presence, and also to catch unsuspecting insects climbing from the ground. When threatened, these geckos will open their jaws wide and let out a loud call that's reminiscent of a child's scream.
translated_description: 在马达加斯加曼塔迪亚国家公园的一棵雨林树上，一只苔藓叶尾壁虎（学名：Uroplatus sikorae）正明目张胆地隐藏着。这种壁虎拥有不可思议的伪装能力，这在遍布目光锐利的掠食性鸟类的森林中至关重要。休息时，它们会面朝下方，以避免眼睛反射光线惊动头顶的鸟类，同时也能捕捉从地面爬上来的毫无防备的昆虫。当受到威胁时，这些壁虎会张开大嘴，发出类似孩童尖叫的响亮叫声。
